entities.text:
Mohd. Abdul Amair And Another vs The State Of Telangana And
Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners-Accused Nos.1 & 4 to quash the proceedings against them in FIR No.20 of 2023 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Boath Police Station, Adilabad District.

The offences alleged against them are under Sections 420, 199 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC'), 156 (3) of Cr.P.C.
2. Heard both sides.

3. After arguing sometime, learned counsel for the petitioners confines his prayer to direct the police to follow the procedure prescribed under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. for the reason of the offences alleged against the petitioners is punishable less than seven (07) years.

In view of the aforesaid submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners, this Criminal Petition is disposed of directing the Investigating Officer in respect of FIR No.20 of 2023 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Boath Police Station, Adilabad District, to strictly follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1.
